title: Pilot weather decision support
summary: Three design cycles of OWSAS, an onboard 3D weather system, evaluated with expert airline pilots in a Boeing 737-800 simulator.

title: Context-sensitive documentation for pilots
summary: An iPad procedure system driven by live aircraft data, evaluated against paper documentation in an Airbus A320 simulator during flaps-malfunction and fuel-leak scenarios.

title: Nuclear plant information system adoption
summary: Two weeks of field research at three nuclear plants to find why operators weren't adopting the Digital Plant Viewer, with recommendations on design, access and training.

title: Firefighter-robot cooperation
summary: Observing firefighting teams and building a research-informed proof of concept for how firefighters and robots cooperate in hazardous environments.

title: Supporting high-stakes personal decisions
context: Round Feather, for Meta and a non-profit
summary: Evaluative research for Meta's Paven financial wellbeing app and a platform supporting people through an unexpected pregnancy.
